polynomial.meaning: site potential derivative p=V_prime, identical at every vertex

domain.coordinate_type: one finite nonnegative IEEE754 binary64; no boolean, string, arbitrary integer or arbitrary precision input
domain.signed_zero: both signs denote the same exact rational zero
domain.graph: simple loop-free oriented graph of maximum undirected degree two
domain.scope: bounded evaluation domain only; support theorem remains restricted to ATC-SUP-MW-AOS-v1 target box and charge 5

evaluation.input_conversion: exact rational represented by each binary64 coordinate
evaluation.polynomial: five exact subtractions and five exact multiplications in roots_in_evaluation_order, accumulator initially one
evaluation.laplacian: B*B_transpose with outward oriented incidence and unit edge weights; edge order is graph.live_edge_ids
evaluation.component_mean: exact sum of p values in live-node order within each connected component, divided by its exact integer size
evaluation.potential_rounding: one roundTiesToEven to binary64 per consumed potential coordinate, after full exact assembly
evaluation.mobility: eta times all-one W, exactly 1/4 per edge
evaluation.flux: exact -eta*B_transpose*rounded_potential, then one roundTiesToEven to binary64 per consumed flux coordinate
evaluation.nonfinite_policy: reject nonfinite inputs and nonfinite rounded final outputs; never clamp or fall back
evaluation.intermediate_policy: retain exact rational polynomial and gauge intermediates even if individually outside binary64; only consumed rounded outputs must fit

work_bound.assembly: fixed incidence traversal over at most 16 vertices and 32 edges; no adaptive solver or polynomial-degree growth
work_bound.arithmetic_bound_basis: finite binary64 input domain, fixed degree/coefficient rationals, fixed graph bounds and exact component means; no unbounded precision input or arbitrary polynomial
work_bound.exceeding_domain: reject before exact arithmetic; never widen or approximate silently

initializer_successor.potential_binding: this entire identity payload, not only symbolic_id
initializer_successor.conformance_evidence: public role-qualified construction record containing W_base, Phi_base and J_ref; missing or null derived evidence fails conformance
initializer_successor.conformance_states: both unperturbed and off-root current/reset resources with distinct reset; independent exact polynomial and stage-rounded flux oracle
initializer_successor.insufficient_test: W_A_init=1 alone cannot detect an omitted site term
initializer_successor.historical_policy: grcv4-a-target-reference-pass-v1 remains unchanged; successor schema/replay/release admission is still required
